metadataMethod: TypeScript AST identifies source name/description/role; evaluated shaders@4.0.0 registry supplies generated categories, props and requiresChild; names/descriptions/declared categories checked against source

components.name: AngularBlur
components.description: Radial motion blur rotating around a center point

components.name: Arc
components.description: Pie sector (arc wedge) with adjustable radius and aperture angle

components.name: Ascii
components.description: Convert imagery to ASCII character art

components.name: Aurora
components.description: Mesmerizing aurora borealis with layered curtains, vertical rays, and flowing light.

components.name: BarShift
components.description: Slices content into parallel bars, each offset independently for a fractured or glitch-like effect

components.name: BarnDoors
components.description: Split the content along a center line and wipe outward in both directions

components.name: Beam
components.description: A beam of light from one point to another.

components.name: Bend
components.description: Bends the ends of the frame toward you like a curved display — content at the edges swells closer under real perspective, or curls away when the strength goes negative

components.name: Blob
components.description: Organic animated blob with 3D lighting and gradients

components.name: BlockDissolve
components.description: Dissolve the content away as a grid of blocks vanishing in random order

components.name: BlockNoise
components.description: Blocky value noise with soft cells that morph over time

components.name: BlueNoise
components.description: High-frequency blue noise — even, grainy speckle ideal for dithering

components.name: Blur
components.description: A simple Gaussian blur effect

components.name: Boids
components.description: A living murmuration of hundreds of flocking agents drawn as crisp arrows, streaks, dots or glowing comets — separation, alignment and cohesion drive fluid, splitting-and-merging ribbons, agents flash toward an excited color when scattered, and the cursor acts as an attractor or a predator

components.name: BokehBlur
components.description: Photographic lens blur where bright highlights bloom into aperture-shaped discs

components.name: BrickPattern
components.description: Classic brick wall pattern with alternating rows and mortar gaps

components.name: BrightnessContrast
components.description: Adjust brightness and contrast of the image

components.name: BrushedMetal
components.description: Photorealistic brushed metal — a satin anodised surface combed with fine directional grain that smears the reflected studio and key light into the long anisotropic streaks of real brushed aluminium, steel, gold or copper

components.name: Bulge
components.description: Magnify or pinch content around a center point

components.name: CRTScreen
components.description: Retro CRT monitor simulation with scanlines

components.name: CarbonFiber
components.description: Photorealistic woven carbon fibre — interlaced tows whose anisotropic sheen flips ninety degrees cell to cell, raised into a quilted weave and finished with a glossy clearcoat that mirrors the studio. Plain or twill, in any shape.

components.name: Chalkboard
components.description: Renders content as a chalk drawing on a blackboard, with edge strokes and cross-hatch shading

components.name: ChannelBlur
components.description: Independent blur for red, green, and blue channels

components.name: CheckerWipe
components.description: Wipe the content away as a checkerboard of fading squares

components.name: Checkerboard
components.description: Classic checkerboard pattern with two alternating colors

components.name: Chevron
components.description: Animated chevron / zigzag stripe pattern

components.name: ChromaFlow
components.description: Interactive liquid flow effect that follows your cursor

components.name: ChromaticAberration
components.description: Separate RGB channels for a prismatic distortion effect

components.name: Chrome
components.description: Studio-lit mirror chrome — a precision-machined shape with a controllable polished bevel, softly convex faces and a photographic studio reflected in them: one huge frontal softbox, black flags, and thin warm/cool strip lights that fringe amber and ice-blue exactly where the reflections break

components.name: Circle
components.description: Generate a circle with adjustable size and softness

components.name: ColorWheel
components.description: A directional gradient that smoothly cycles through rainbow colors or a custom set of three colors

components.name: CompressionArtifacts
components.description: Simulates lossy JPEG compression — 8×8 DCT block quantization, blockiness, ringing and color bleed

components.name: ConcentricSpin
components.description: Concentric rings that each rotate the underlying image by different amounts

components.name: ConicGradient
components.description: Colors sweep in a full circle around a center point, like a color wheel

components.name: ContourLines
components.description: Draw topographical contour lines based on luminance or alpha

components.name: CornerPin
components.description: Pin each corner of the content to an arbitrary position for a free perspective warp

components.name: Crescent
components.description: Crescent moon shape — an outer circle with an inner circle subtracted

components.name: Cross
components.description: Plus / cross shape with adjustable arm length, width, and rounding

components.name: Crystal
components.description: Diamond-like crystal lens with faceted refraction.

components.name: CurlNoise
components.description: Swirling divergence-free flow field that drifts over time

components.name: CursorRipples
components.description: Fluid-like ripple distortion

components.name: CursorTrail
components.description: Animated trail effect that tracks cursor movement

components.name: DataMosh
components.description: Corrupted-codec motion smearing — macroblocks lock in place and drag their pixels across the frame in liquid trails, each recovering on its own clock, like a video stream that lost its keyframes

components.name: DiamondGradient
components.description: Diamond-shaped gradient radiating from a center point using Manhattan distance

components.name: DiamondWipe
components.description: Wipe the content away through a lattice of growing diamonds

components.name: DiffuseBlur
components.description: Grain-like pixel displacement at random

components.name: DisplacementMap
components.description: Distorts child content using another layer's pixels as a displacement map

components.name: Dither
components.description: Dithering effect with multiple pattern options

components.name: DotGrid
components.description: Grid of dots with optional twinkling animation

components.name: DropShadow
components.description: Adds a soft shadow behind the child content based on its alpha silhouette

components.name: Duotone
components.description: Map colors to two tones based on luminance

components.name: Ellipse
components.description: Ellipse with independently adjustable horizontal and vertical radii

components.name: Emboss
components.description: Embossed / debossed relief shading on top of child content, driven by a custom shape

components.name: Engraving
components.description: Copper-plate line engraving — the image is redrawn as flowing line work whose weight swells with darkness, lines displaced by the form like a banknote portrait: a single plate, cross-hatched shadow plates, or one continuous spiral cut

components.name: ErosionNoise
components.description: Branching, hydraulic-erosion ridges carved into noise

components.name: Exposure
components.description: Multiplicative exposure (gain) on the child. Unlike additive brightness, it scales values around black — blacks stay black while highlights can be pushed past 1.0 to feed HDR bloom and tone-mapping roll-off. Pointwise, so no extra render pass is needed.

components.name: FallingLines
components.description: Directional falling lines with a leading-to-trailing color fade

components.name: FilmGrain
components.description: Analog film grain texture overlay, weighted toward darker areas

components.name: FilmStock
components.description: Real analog film color from measured film-emulation LUTs — ten classic stock looks with emulsion halation and projector gate weave

components.name: Flip
components.description: Mirror content horizontally, vertically, or both

components.name: FloatingParticles
components.description: Drifting, twinkling motes — thousands of real simulated particles floating in a shared heading with per-particle wander and variance, and a cursor that stirs the field with a gust that settles back into the drift

components.name: FlowField
components.description: Fluid-like distortion with constant smooth motion

components.name: Flower
components.description: Petal shape with N lobes and adjustable inner-to-outer radius ratio

components.name: FlowingGradient
components.description: Liquid silk gradient with organic flowing color bands

components.name: FlutedGlass
components.description: Full-screen fluted glass effect — refracts content through repeating cylindrical bars

components.name: Fog
components.description: Fog that fills the screen and interacts with the mouse

components.name: Form3D
components.description: Wraps child content onto a 3D raymarched shape with lighting.

components.name: FractalNoise
components.description: Multi-octave fractal Brownian motion noise texture with true noise evolution

components.name: Frost
components.description: Photoreal frozen ice — thickness-driven subsurface scattering that reads as a solid block, with fine frost crystals creeping in from the edges

components.name: GaborNoise
components.description: Oriented sine-grain noise with a fingerprint-like flow

components.name: Glass
components.description: Optically realistic glass lens driven in a custom shape

components.name: GlassTiles
components.description: Refraction-like distortion in a tile grid pattern

components.name: Glitch
components.description: Digital glitch that melts pixels and distorts colors

components.name: Glow
components.description: Soft glow effect with adjustable intensity

components.name: Godrays
components.description: Volumetric light rays emanating from a point

components.name: Goo
components.description: Photoreal wet liquid — animated 3D metaball blobs that merge and bulge to loosely form the shape, with sliding wet highlights, a clearcoat rim and a translucent body

components.name: GradientMap
components.description: Maps source luminance through an animated color gradient (Photoshop-style gradient map)

components.name: Grayscale
components.description: Convert colors to black and white

components.name: Grid
components.description: Simple grid lines pattern with adjustable thickness and rotation

components.name: GridDistortion
components.description: Interactive grid distortion controlled by mouse position

components.name: Group
components.description: Container for organizing and composing child effects — supports flex-like flow layout (column/row stacking via the flow prop)

components.name: HTMLInCanvas
components.description: Render live HTML/DOM content as a WebGPU texture layer via the html-in-canvas API. Requires Chrome Canary with chrome://flags/#canvas-draw-element enabled.

components.name: Halftone
components.description: Halftone dot pattern effect for printing aesthetics

components.name: Heart
components.description: Heart shape with adjustable size

components.name: Heatmap
components.description: Thermal-camera heat flowing through any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape. Powered by Paper Shaders.

components.name: HexGrid
components.description: Honeycomb hexagonal grid pattern

components.name: Hologram
components.description: Volumetric sci-fi hologram — a translucent emissive projection of the shape with fresnel-lit edges, depth scan-lines that wrap 3D forms, CRT scanlines, flicker and beam wobble

components.name: Holographic
components.description: Iridescent holographic foil sticker with animated rainbow sheen and glitter flakes

components.name: HueShift
components.description: Rotate hue around the color wheel

components.name: ImageTexture
components.description: Display an image with customizable object-fit modes

components.name: InkFlow
components.description: Drag to paint swirling ribbons of ink through a real fluid field — eddies keep evolving after you let go

components.name: Invert
components.description: Invert RGB colors while preserving alpha

components.name: IrisWipe
components.description: Reveal through an expanding circle growing from a center point

components.name: Irradiance
components.description: Photorealistic light spilling around the edge of any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape — any number of movable colored point lights strike the silhouette and the lit edges irradiate their surroundings, gathered in a compute pass with real cast shadows, mixing where they meet and burning to white at the rim

components.name: IsometricCubes
components.description: Isometric tumbling-blocks tiling — a 3D cube illusion (rhombille pattern)

components.name: Kaleidoscope
components.description: Create a kaleidoscope effect with radial mirrored segments

components.name: KeyFrames
components.description: Motion-tracking overlay — trackers hunt and follow features in the content, dropping keyframe diamonds behind them along their motion paths, like a compositor mid-track

components.name: LensDistortion
components.description: Split content into shifting chromatic layers with barrel or pincushion lens warp. Powered by Paper Shaders.

components.name: LensFlare
components.description: Realistic camera lens flare with artifacts.

components.name: LightEdge
components.description: Glowing, pulsing light racing around the edge of any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape. Powered by Paper Shaders.

components.name: LightLeak
components.description: Photorealistic film light leak — warm overexposed light bleeding in from a draggable anchor point, with streak bands, chromatic fringing, and slow breathing that evolves over time

components.name: Line
components.description: Draw a straight line between two points with color, thickness, and solid, dashed, or dotted styles

components.name: LinearBlur
components.description: Directional motion blur in a specific angle

components.name: LinearGradient
components.description: Create smooth linear color gradients

components.name: LinearWipe
components.description: Wipe the content away along a straight edge with a soft feathered transition

components.name: LiquidMetal
components.description: Flowing liquid chrome — a molten reflective surface that wraps the shape, sweeping a procedural studio reflection across animated folds with crisp speculars and prismatic edges

components.name: Liquify
components.description: Liquid-like interactive deformation effect

components.name: MagneticFilings
components.description: Thousands of tiny iron filings scattered on paper that swing to align with a magnetic field around the cursor, tracing out the field lines — a dipole whose axis follows the cursor's motion draws the classic two-lobed swirl, and every sweep of the magnet sends a glowing wave of filings flipping and settling

components.name: Marble
components.description: Classic marble swirl and vein texture using noise-warped sine waves

components.name: MeshGradient
components.description: Flowing mesh gradient of soft drifting color swaths whose seams wrap through the palette

components.name: Mirror
components.description: Mirror content across a line defined by center point and angle

components.name: MultiPointGradient
components.description: Five individually placed color points blended together by proximity — drag each point to shape the gradient

components.name: Nebula
components.description: A volumetric gas nebula sealed inside polished glass; billowing emission clouds with hollow dark cavities and hot glowing cores, star fields drifting at real depth behind the gas, all refracted through the curved walls of the shape and dressed with studio reflections

components.name: Neon
components.description: Photorealistic neon tube / 3D pipe effect driven by a custom shape

components.name: NoiseDissolve
components.description: Dissolve the content away through an organic noise pattern

components.name: ObjectTracker
components.description: Computer-vision style object detection overlay — draws bounding boxes and labels around detected regions of the content below, with grid, quadtree and mosaic layouts.

components.name: Obsidian
components.description: Dark tinted glass whose faces stay near-black while every surface turning away from the viewer ignites with a flowing iridescent gradient — vivid color living only on the oblique walls and bevels

components.name: PagePeel
components.description: Curl the content up from a corner like a peeling page

components.name: Paper
components.description: Applies realistic paper grain and surface roughness to child content

components.name: Parallelogram
components.description: Parallelogram with adjustable width, height and skew

components.name: ParticleField
components.description: Explodes the child content into a breathing 3D field of particles — bright areas float toward you and dark areas recede, the whole relief can be orbited with the camera rotations, and the cursor physically throws particles that spring back home

components.name: ParticleFlow
components.description: Thousands of drifting dust particles carried by a real incompressible fluid field the cursor stirs — drag to plow a wake and the particles ride the eddies and vortices it leaves behind, while a gentle ambient breeze keeps the whole scene breathing on its own

components.name: Particles
components.description: A swarm of simulated particles that settles into the shape, filling it evenly — flat, SVG or true 3D volumes — scattering from the cursor (or chasing it), tumbling when the shape moves, and always drifting back home

components.name: PerlinNoise
components.description: Smooth gradient noise that morphs over time

components.name: Perspective
components.description: Rotate the plane in 3D space with pan and tilt

components.name: PixelSort
components.description: Pixels sort by brightness around the cursor and keep their sorted position, optionally decaying back over time

components.name: PixelThrow
components.description: Throws pixels along the cursor's path like a fluid — brighter (or redder/greener/bluer) pixels are flung farther, then settle back with friction

components.name: Pixelate
components.description: Pixelation effect with adjustable cell size

components.name: Plasma
components.description: Animated effect of glowing plasma

components.name: Plastic
components.description: Glossy molded plastic with photorealistic studio reflections, driven in a custom shape

components.name: PolarCoordinates
components.description: Convert rectangular coordinates to polar space

components.name: Polygon
components.description: Regular polygon with adjustable sides and corner rounding

components.name: Posterize
components.description: Reduce color depth to create a poster effect

components.name: Prism
components.description: A beam of light that fans out and splits into a slowly-rotating rainbow past a controllable point. Transparent background — composite over a dark layer.

components.name: ProgressiveBlur
components.description: Blur that increases progressively in one direction

components.name: RadialGradient
components.description: Radial gradient radiating from a center point

components.name: RadialWipe
components.description: Sweep the content away in a clock-hand arc around a center point

components.name: RandomBars
components.description: Wipe the content away as parallel bars vanishing in random order

components.name: ReactionDiffusion
components.description: A living Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion pattern that fills the layer and blooms wherever you drag the cursor

components.name: RectangularCoordinates
components.description: Convert polar coordinates back to rectangular space

components.name: ReflectivePlane
components.description: Reflective floor that mirrors the content above it

components.name: Repeater
components.description: Repeat the child content in grid, radial or linear layouts with per-instance variation

components.name: Ring
components.description: Annular ring (donut) with adjustable radius and band thickness

components.name: RippleWipe
components.description: Wipe the content away in concentric rings pulsing out from a center point

components.name: Ripples
components.description: Concentric animated ripples emanating from a point

components.name: RoundedRect
components.description: Rounded rectangle with adjustable width, height, and corner rounding

components.name: Saturation
components.description: Adjust color saturation intensity

components.name: Scratches
components.description: Fine hairline scratches, like a worn film or scratched surface

components.name: Sharpness
components.description: Adjust image sharpness using a convolution kernel

components.name: Shatter
components.description: Broken glass effect with tectonic plate displacement

components.name: SimplexNoise
components.description: Organic noise with animated movement

components.name: SineWave
components.description: Animated wave with thickness and softness

components.name: SliceWipe
components.description: Slice the content into strips that slide away in alternating directions

components.name: Smoke
components.description: Realistic fluid smoke simulation with vorticity dynamics

components.name: SmokeFill
components.description: Fill a shape with swirling fluid smoke that interacts with the shape boundary

components.name: SmokeFlow
components.description: Cursor-driven smoke that lingers, swirls, and dissipates with fluid dynamics

components.name: Solarize
components.description: Inverts tones above a luminance threshold — a classic darkroom and photo effect

components.name: SolidColor
components.description: Fill the canvas with a single solid color

components.name: Sparkle
components.description: Twinkling star glints over the bright parts of the layer inside

components.name: Spherize
components.description: Map content onto a 3D sphere surface with depth distortion

components.name: Spiral
components.description: Rotating spiral pattern with animated movement

components.name: Star
components.description: Classic star polygon with straight sides and sharp pointed tips

components.name: Stone
components.description: Applies a marbled stone relief and surface distortion to child content

components.name: Strands
components.description: Flowing ribbons of light with a multi-color gradient

components.name: Stretch
components.description: Stretch content towards a direction from a center point

components.name: Stripes
components.description: Alternating colored stripes with animation

components.name: StudioBackground
components.description: Multi-light studio background with ambient motion.

components.name: SunBurst
components.description: Radial sunburst rays emanating from a center point

components.name: Surface3D
components.description: Drapes child content over a 3D wave surface with perspective and lighting

components.name: Swirl
components.description: Flowing swirl pattern with multi-layered noise

components.name: Teardrop
components.description: Teardrop — a rounded bulb tapering to a sharp point

components.name: Text
components.description: Text with any Google font — multi-line with wrapping, alignment and line height — rendered crisp via a glyph texture

components.name: ThinFilm
components.description: Iridescent thin-film edge

components.name: TiltShift
components.description: Selective focus blur mimicking tilt-shift photography

components.name: TimeTrail
components.description: An Echo-style temporal trail — whatever moves sheds a smooth, decaying long-exposure ghost trail (frame-difference Motion mode works on opaque images and video; Alpha mode trails a shape's coverage), with optional zoom-feedback tunnels and rainbow light-painting

components.name: Tint
components.description: Apply a color tint to the image

components.name: Trapezoid
components.description: Trapezoid with adjustable top and bottom widths and height

components.name: TriangularGrid
components.description: Tiling grid of equilateral triangles with optional animated row offsets

components.name: Tritone
components.description: Map colors to three tones: shadows, midtones, highlights

components.name: Truchet
components.description: Quarter-circle arc tiles that connect to form organic, maze-like flowing curves

components.name: Twirl
components.description: Rotate and twist content around a center point

components.name: VHS
components.description: Analog VHS tape with intermittent tape damage, chroma bleed, and per-scanline noise

components.name: VenetianBlinds
components.description: Wipe the content away behind a set of parallel closing strips

components.name: Vesica
components.description: Vesica piscis (lens shape) formed by the intersection of two overlapping circles

components.name: Vibrance
components.description: Selective saturation adjustment protecting skin tones

components.name: VideoTexture
components.description: Display a video with customizable playback and object-fit modes

components.name: Vignette
components.description: Darkens or tints the edges of the frame, drawing attention toward the center

components.name: Voronoi
components.description: Cellular pattern where each pixel is colored by its distance to the nearest of many scattered points

components.name: Voxels
components.description: Rebuild any shape out of voxels — a flat shape becomes chunky pixel art, a 3D shape a lit voxel model with smooth ambient occlusion, cast shadows, a key light you can orbit or drive, and per-cube color

components.name: Water
components.description: Translucent water — a refractive, light-absorbing body that deepens to its color with thickness, wrapped in a wind-driven wave surface that reflects a procedural sky, with Fresnel-bright grazing edges and foam breaking on the crests and shoreline

components.name: Watercolor
components.description: Painterly watercolor look — Kuwahara flattening, pigment edge darkening, paper grain and bleeding

components.name: WaveDistortion
components.description: Wave-based distortion with multiple waveform types

components.name: Waveform
components.description: Audio-visualizer waveform — equalizer bars, a filled wave, an oscilloscope line, or a dot matrix — driven by a simulated signal whose amplitude you can map to your own audio level

components.name: WaveletNoise
components.description: Rotating banded wavelets that ripple as they animate

components.name: Weave
components.description: Interlaced textile weave pattern with two thread colors going over and under each other

components.name: WebcamTexture
components.description: Display a live webcam feed with customizable object-fit modes

components.name: Wool
components.description: Applies an interwoven fibrous fabric texture and distortion to child content

components.name: WorleyNoise
components.description: Cellular noise field — distance-based, with selectable feature combinations and fractal octaves

components.name: ZoomBlur
components.description: Radial zoom blur expanding from a center point
